row.evidence: Coassemble's help centre says it offers Log in with Microsoft as a social login but "does not offer Microsoft Enterprise SSO", and that access is "not provisioned or de-provisioned centrally"; no SCIM is listed on any plan.
row.notes: New in 2026-09. Coassemble now sells itself as an API-first training platform with flat annual plans (Build $2,500/yr, Scale from $5,000/yr, Partner from $20,000/yr billed yearly; Build is $250/mo monthly) and unlimited creators, so per-user fields stay null. No SAML/OIDC SSO and no SCIM; sign-in is email/password or Google, Microsoft or Slack social login. Workspace members are invited by email and removed by hand in Settings > Members. The REST Identities API (Build and above) manages embedded learner identities, not workspace members. Not found in the Okta, Entra or JumpCloud catalogues.

plans.name: Sandbox
plans.notes: Free trial sandbox with the full API and builder; not a production tier.

scim.notes: No SCIM endpoint is documented anywhere (pricing comparison of 123 features, help centre llms.txt index, developer docs). The help centre says Coassemble does not offer enterprise SSO and that access is not provisioned or de-provisioned centrally. 'false' is by absence plus that statement.

auth.notes: Authorization header COASSEMBLE:{workspace id}:{API key}; keys are managed by Owner/Developer roles.

capabilities.notes: The Identities API manages embedded (headless) learner identities and their client tenants, not workspace members (Owner/Creator/Developer). Update only replaces metadata. No documented API for inviting or removing workspace members.

endpoints.purpose: Delete all objects for a client
List learner users (paginated, optional clientIdentifier filter)
Delete a learner user, choosing what happens to their courses

webhooks_user_events.notes: Webhooks cover course.created, course.commenced and course.completed only; no user lifecycle events.

rate_limits.text: 100 requests per minute per API key on /api/v1/headless, fixed one-minute windows; 429 with Retry-After.

okta.notes: OIN search returns no results; /integrations/coassemble/ returns 404.

entra.notes: No Microsoft Learn SaaS tutorial (coassemble-tutorial returns 404).

jumpcloud.notes: JumpCloud support pages return 403 to plain requests.

fallbacks.notes: No SSO, so no JIT. Members are invited by email (comma-separated list) from Settings > Members.
